cases.expected: The password control uses a masked password input.
cases.actual: The terminal login form rendered the password control as input type `password`; the screenshot shows masked characters.

cases.description: Valid master login opens the trading dashboard
cases.expected: Valid master credentials open the dashboard and authorized MAM reads succeed.
cases.actual: The browser reached `/test/home/dashboard`; the protected Real MAM relationship request returned HTTP 200 and the dashboard rendered.

cases.description: Fresh unauthenticated browser cannot read account or MAM data
cases.expected: Protected account, positions and MAM relationship endpoints return 401 without a token.
cases.actual: With no local/session storage and no authorization header, account, positions and MAM relationship reads each returned HTTP 401.

cases.description: MAM widget and trading panel use the same Real Hedging instance
cases.expected: A MAM master dashboard must bind both MAM controls and order-entry/trade panels to Real Hedging.
cases.actual: After master login, the trading panel displayed Paper Hedging and called `/paper/account`, `/paper/orders` and `/paper/history`, while the MAM widget simultaneously called `/real/mam/masters`, `/real/mam/follows` and `/real/mam/shares`.

cases.description: Trading credentials are not placed in iframe URL query parameters
cases.expected: Session and broker credentials use protected headers or an equivalent mechanism and do not appear in URLs.
cases.actual: The cross-origin chart iframe URL contained both `brokerToken` and `userToken` query parameters. Values were redacted from evidence and the broker token was revoked successfully through logout (HTTP 204).
